✦ About AG Interiors

Where craftsmanship meets vision

AG Interiors is a full-service interior design studio based in Coimbatore, dedicated to creating spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful. Founded with a deep appreciation for natural materials and elegant form, we have spent over 15 years shaping homes, offices, and commercial spaces across Tamil Nadu.

Our team brings together designers, craftsmen, and project managers who share one belief — that every space has a story waiting to be told. We listen, we design, and we deliver on time, within budget, and beyond expectation.

✦ What We Do

Our Services

From a single room to an entire building — we design it all with the same passion and precision.

01

Residential Design

Homes, villas, and apartments transformed into personal sanctuaries. We craft interiors that reflect your personality with warmth and elegance.

02

Commercial Interiors

Offices, hotels, and restaurants designed to impress clients and inspire teams. Functional aesthetics that speak your brand's language.

03

Modular Kitchen

Beautiful, ergonomic modular kitchens with premium cabinetry, smart storage solutions, and finishes that age like fine wood.

04

Custom Furniture

Handcrafted furniture tailored to your space and taste. Solid wood, premium upholstery, and unique designs that become heirlooms.

05

Space Planning

Strategic layout and flow planning that maximises every square foot. We turn awkward spaces into masterfully utilised environments.

06

Renovation & Remodel

Breathe new life into existing spaces. From subtle refreshes to full structural transformations, we make the old feel remarkably new.
